from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess

 p=root/rel
 if not p.is_file(): missing.append(rel); continue
 actual[rel]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
mismatches={rel:{"expected":expected[rel],"actual":actual.get(rel)} for rel in expected if actual.get(rel)!=expected[rel]}
# Rediscover the frozen surface so newly added product/test/fixture/runner/prior-task files are detected.
paths=set()
for pattern in ("src/**/*.py","tests/**/*.py","scripts/validation/**/*","samples/**/*"):
 for p in root.glob(pattern):
  if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts: paths.add(p)
for rel in (
 "run_experiment.py",
 "docs/01_项目现状/PROJECT_BOTTLENECK_MAP.md",
 "docs/04_验证体系/项目级能力评测基线_v1.md",
 "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1",
 "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_UNRELATED_MALFORMED_REPAIR_V1",
 "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/CONTRACT.md",
):
 p=root/rel
 if p.is_file(): paths.add(p)
 elif p.is_dir():
  for f in p.rglob("*"):
   if f.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in f.parts: paths.add(f)
rediscovered={p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in paths}
expected_set=set(expected)
new_frozen_files=sorted(rediscovered-expected_set); missing_frozen_files=sorted(expected_set-rediscovered)
head=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
current_status=subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","core.quotePath=false","status","--short","--branch"],text=True)
ev1=(root/"docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/evidence/EV-01.stdout.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
initial_status=ev1[ev1.index("## main..."):]
checks={
 "head_unchanged":head==manifest_doc["head"]=="71a3acbbd9622b68a8064381b9034e07c1f4d700",
 "all_frozen_files_present":not missing,
 "all_frozen_hashes_unchanged":not mismatches,
 "no_new_files_on_frozen_surface":not new_frozen_files,
 "no_removed_files_on_frozen_surface":not missing_frozen_files,
 "git_status_shape_unchanged":current_status==initial_status,
 "target_unchanged":actual["samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json"]=="f5dc05501c79958b197ea7a727e12660756145da870b897496a9ccac714cacee",
 "runner_unchanged":actual["scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py"]=="a7d71fd92cacd7ebdb8e4a1da383067aa57b0e6dcbf20c41f043f4e461fc1fc4",
 "before_unchanged":actual["docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence/before.json"]=="83e0409efd5e8df688756f0606f27fd1dfb8e77c9123c1241de69a0f735c08ff",
 "known_attempt_implementation_unchanged":actual["src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/known_payment_attempt.py"]=="1fa1a320ceaf4228d56bd796efdeb6f957a20286e7124b8ccbcbceff80e47278",
 "runtime_gate_implementation_unchanged":actual["src/agentic_payment_experiment/webshop_runtime_gate.py"]=="1aa1c3e4ddaaf5f360a75bda2224d83c5b5b6e4b981567795816e62a0600bf93",
}
print("CHECKS="+json.dumps(checks,sort_keys=True))
print("FROZEN_FILE_COUNT="+str(len(expected)))
print("MISMATCHES="+json.dumps(mismatches,sort_keys=True))
print("NEW_FROZEN_FILES="+json.dumps(new_frozen_files))
print("MISSING_FROZEN_FILES="+json.dumps(missing_frozen_files))
print("MANIFEST_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("HEAD="+head)
print("STATUS_START")
print(current_status,end="")
print("STATUS_END")
if not all(checks.values()): raise SystemExit(1)
